5. Harshness Bias: I avoided over-penalizing the 'rabbit vs hare' taxonomy issue. While the prompt said 'rabbits' and taxonomy described 'hares', the visual representation is clearly leporid. Penalizing for species-level biological accuracy when the visual intent is met would be too harsh. I focused on the actual spatial failure instead.

6. Atom Score Review: All atom scores are justified. Atom 2 is the only failure. Tax scores are 1.0 as no taxonomy violations affect the core QA pairs significantly enough to warrant deduction beyond the spatial error.

7. Upward Override Justification: No upward overrides were made. My assessment matches the Router's identification of the spatial error. I maintained the 0.0 score for Atom 2 based on independent visual verification of depth cues.

Final scores remain unchanged as the initial assessment was accurate and consistent with all checklist criteria.
